posts.title: Touch vs sight
posts.description: Unpacking my things after months in storage, I rediscovered a book I bought just before the move: Sculpture by Johann Gottfried von Herder. I only made it partway through before it went into a box, so I picked up where I left off and, I gotta say, it was a nice read. A takeaway from Herder's book revolves around how we perceive art.
